25700.meaning2: Chapter 5 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

25701.meaning1: duty of an emperor; responsibility of a universal ruler

examples.text: iṅgha tvaṃ, tāta, ariye cakkavattivatte vattāhi. ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ te ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃnhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavissati sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūran'ti.

25702.commentary: (MNa) cakkaratanaṃ vatteti, catūhi sampatticakkehi vatteti, tehi ca paraṃ vatteti, parahitāya ca iriyāpathacakkānaṃ vatto etasmiṃ atthī'ti cakkavattī.

examples.text: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti
idaṃ kho, ānanda, atthavasaṃ paṭicca rājā cakkavattī thūp'āraho

bhūtapubbaṃ, ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano nāma ahosi khattiyo muddh'ābhisitto, cakkavattīdhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto. rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa ayaṃ kusinārā kusāvatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.
pārevatā ravihaṃsā, cakkavākā nadīcarā, kokilā sukasāḷikā, upajīvanti taṃ saraṃ.

25707.meaning2: (circular) rock supposed to encircle the earth

25708.notes:
(MW) of a mythical range of mountains (encircling the orb of the earth and being the limit of light and darkness).
Could the circle of wild animals be the zodiac? That concept goes back as far as ancient Babylon.

examples.text: cattālīsa samā dantā, kesā lomā ca sabbaso, devā hariṃsu ek'ekaṃ, cakkavāḷaparamparā'ti.
evaṃ nisinne bodhisatte sakaladasasahassacakkavāḷadevatā sannipatitvā sādhukāraṃ datvā

25710.meaning1: mountain range encircling the world system

25711.commentary: (SNa) cakkavīriyo'ti vīriyacakko, kāyikacetasika-saṅkhātāni dve vīriyāni assa cakkānī'ti attho.

examples.text: ratho sīlaparikkhāro, jhān'akkho cakkavīriyo, upekkhā dhurasamādhi, anicchā parivāraṇaṃ.

25712.meaning2: (one) who turns the wheel afterwards, who keeps the wheels rolling

examples.text: tattha vattamān'uppannam'eva samudācār'uppannaṃ. cakkh'ādīnaṃ pana āpāthagate ārammaṇe pubbabhāge anuppajjamānam'pi kilesajātaṃ ārammaṇassa adhiggahitattā eva aparabhāge avassamuppattito ārammaṇ'ādhiggahit'uppannan'ti vuccati.

cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, cakkh'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, cakkh'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto cakkhusmim'pi nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

25716.meaning1: field of the eye; visual sphere

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ, sot'āyatanaṃ, ghān'āyatanaṃ, jivh'āyatanaṃ, kāy'āyatanaṃ, man'āyatanaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saḷāyatanaṃ.
cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkh'āyatanaṃ sot'āyatanaṃ ghān'āyatanaṃ jivh'āyatanaṃ kāy'āyatanaṃ man'āyatanaṃ

25717.synonym: akkha, akkhi, dassana, nayana, netta, locana

examples.text: muttā ca tato sā bhikkhunī, agamī buddhavarassa santikaṃ, passiya varapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, cakkhu āsi yathā purāṇakan'ti.

yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya, so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti
yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti
tañ'hi te, māgaṇḍiya, ariyaṃ cakkhuṃ n'atthi yena tvaṃ ariyena cakkhunā ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi, nibbānaṃ passeyyāsī'ti.
katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyā? sattānaṃ cut'ūpapāto, bhikkhave, cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyo.
idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan'ti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
ubho khañjā ubho kuṇī, ubho visamacakkhukā, ubhinnaṃ piḷakā jātā, n'āhaṃ passāmi illisan'ti.

25723.meaning1: which produces vision; which creates clarity

examples.text: nekkhammavitakko, bhikkhave, anandhakaraṇo cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.

25724.grammar: adj, comp, fem nom sg of cakkhukaraṇa
25724.meaning1: which produces vision; which creates clarity

examples.text: lobhassa ca pahānāya dosassa ca pahānāya atthi majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati
ete kho, bhikkhave, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

25726.commentary: (SNa) cakkhudo'ti andhakāre cakkhumantānam'pi rūpadassan'ābhāvato dīpado cakkhudo nāma hoti, anuruddhatthero viya dibbacakkhu sampadam'pi labhati.

examples.text: kiṃdado balado hoti, kiṃdado hoti vaṇṇado, kiṃdado sukhado hoti, kiṃdado hoti cakkhudo, ko ca sabbadado hoti, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.
annado balado hoti, vatthado hoti vaṇṇado, yānado sukhado hoti, dīpado hoti cakkhudo.

25727.meaning1: giving vision; providing clarity; bestowing understanding

examples.text: paññaṃ imaṃ passa tathāgatānaṃ, aggi yathā pajjalito nisīthe, ālokadā cakkhudadā bhavanti, ye āgatānaṃ vinayanti kaṅkhan'ti.

25728.commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu cakkhupasādo cakkhudhātu, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpadhātu, cakkhupasādavatthukaṃ cittaṃ cakkhuviññāṇadhātu.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.

25729.commentary: (MNa) na ca me cakkhunissitaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇañ'c'āpi me cakkhunissitaṃ na bhavissati.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na cakkhuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.
tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha, rakkhatha cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, cakkhu'ndriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatha.
pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti. katamāni pañca? cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ.

25731.meaning1: ending of the sense of sight

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā cakkhu'ndriyaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti… na me te, bhikkhave … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.

25732.meaning1: leading to the ending of the sense of sight

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā cakkhu'ndriyaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti… na me te, bhikkhave … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.

25733.meaning1: arising of the sense of sight

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā cakkhu'ndriyaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, cakkhu'ndriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti… na me te, bhikkhave … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.

25734.meaning1: restraint of the sense of sight

examples.text: yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvaraṃ asaṃvutassa viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvaraṃ saṃvutassa viharato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

25735.meaning1: with the sense of sight restrained

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… sot'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… ghān'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… jivh'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… kāy'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… man'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.

25736.meaning1: range of sight; scope of vision
25736.commentary: (DNa) cakkhupathasmin'ti cakkhupasāde āpāthe vā. so devānaṃ cakkhussa āpāthe sambhavanīyo pattabbo na hoti, na abhibhavatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. heṭṭhā heṭṭhā hi devatā upar'ūpari devānaṃ oḷārikaṃ katvā māpitameva attabhāvaṃ passituṃ sakkonti, vedapaṭilābhan'ti tuṭṭhipaṭilābhaṃ.

examples.text: yo kho pana, bhante, brahmuno pakativaṇṇo anabhisambhavanīyo so devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ cakkhupathasmiṃ.

25738.meaning1: based on the sense of sight

25741.meaning1: arising of vision; restoring of sight; arising of insight

examples.text: so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya, cakkhūni visodheyya. tassa saha cakkh'uppādā yo amusmiṃ telamalikate sāhuḷicīre chandarāgo so pahīyetha. tañ'ca naṃ purisaṃ amittato'pi daheyya, paccatthikato'pi daheyya
so tvaṃ ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi, nibbānaṃ passeyyāsi. tassa te saha cakkh'uppādā yo pañcas'upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo so pahīyetha

gopakhumo'ti ettha pakhuman'ti sakalacakkhubhaṇḍaṃ adhippetaṃ, taṃ kāḷavacchakassa bahaladhātukaṃ hoti, rattavacchakassa vippasannaṃ, taṃmuhuttajāta-taruṇa-ratta-vacchaka-sadisa-cakkhubhaṇḍo'ti attho.

25744.commentary: (MNa) dassanapariṇāyak'aṭṭhena cakkhubhūto… atha vā cakkhu viya bhūto'ti cakkhubhūto'ti evam'etesu padesu attho veditabbo.

examples.text: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato
cakkhuno bhūto cakkhubhūto, cakkhubhūto iva bhūto yo bhagavā so'yaṃ cakkhubhūto, bhagavā.

25745.meaning1: with eyes; who can see; who has vision; gifted with sight

examples.text: maggān'aṭṭh'aṅgiko seṭṭho, saccānaṃ caturo padā, virāgo seṭṭho dhammānaṃ, dvipadānañ'ca cakkhumā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso āpāthagatānaṃ rūpānaṃ adassanakāmo assa, so nimīleyya vā aññena vā apalokeyya.

25746.meaning1: person with sight; who can see

examples.text: so suṇeyya cakkhumato bhāsamānassa, chekaṃ vata, bho, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti!
cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti, evam'evaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānarogo jivhārogo kāyarogo sīsarogo kaṇṇarogo mukharogo dantarogo oṭṭharogo kāso sāso pināso ḍāho jaro kucchirogo mucchā

25750.meaning1: the ocean of the eye; ocean (of forms perceived by) the eye
25750.meaning2: the ocean of the eye; ocean (of forms perceived by) the eye
25750.commentary: (NPa) ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari cakkhusamuddan'ti ayaṃ bhikkhu cakkhusaṅkhātaṃ samuddaṃ tiṇṇo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yo taṃ rūpamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari cakkhusamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ.

25752.meaning1: contact with the eye; visual impression; visual experience
25752.commentary: (DNa) cakkhusamphasso'ti cakkhunissito samphasso. (MNa) cakkhusamphasso'ti cakkhumhi samphasso. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphasso. cakkhusamphasso'pi anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
yam'p'idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā tam'pi suññaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā.

25753.meaning1: caused by eye contact; produced by a visual impression; born from eye experience

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.

25754.meaning1: feeling arisen from a visual impression; sensation produced by a visual experience

25755.meaning1: dependent on feeling tone arisen from visual experience

examples.text: tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na cakkhusamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhusamphassajāvedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na cakkhusamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhusamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

25757.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of cakkhusamphassapaccaya
25757.meaning1: dependent on contact with the eye; due to a visual impression; because of a visual experience
25757.construction:
cakkhu + samphassa + paccaya + ā
cakkhusamphassapaccaya + ā

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusmiṃ sati cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ.
yam'p'idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā

25758.meaning1: visual experience and the corresponding field of consciousness; visual impression and the associated dimension of knowing
25758.commentary: (SNa) cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kiṃ pana, pāpima, te balībaddehīti? mam'eva, samaṇa, cakkhu, mama rūpā, mama cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasi?

cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ. chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

25766.meaning1: eye and ear; eyes and ears

examples.text: aguttaṃ cakkhusotasmiṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, makkhik'ānupatissanti, saṅkappā rāganissitā.
taṃ yathā? cakkhu ca sotañ'ca cakkhusotaṃ, mukhañ'ca nāsikā ca mukhanāsikaṃ, chavi ca maṃsañ'ca lohitañ'ca chavimaṃsalohitaṃ. evaṃ pāṇy'aṅg'atthe.

25767.meaningLit: to be known by the eye and ear
25767.commentary: (MNa) idāni te dve dhamme dassento cakkhusotaviññeyyesū'ti āha. tattha satthu kāyiko samācāro vīmaṃsakassa cakkhuviññeyyo dhammo nāma. vācasiko samācāro sotaviññeyyo dhammo nāma.

examples.text: vīmaṃsakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena dvīsu dhammesu tathāgato samannesitabbo cakkhusotaviññeyyesu dhammesu, ye saṃkiliṭṭhā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā'ti?

25768.meaning1: good looking; easy on the eye; (comm) good for the eyes
25768.commentary: (ANa) acakkhussan'ti na cakkhūnaṃ hitaṃ, cakkhuṃ visuddhaṃ na karoti.

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane. katame pañca? cakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonandhati, bhattam'assa chādeti.

25769.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Okkantasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 25 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

25770.commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sota-ghāna-jivhā-kāya-viññāṇāni.

examples.text: dvayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti? cakkhuñ'ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.

25771.commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu cakkhupasādo cakkhudhātu, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpadhātu, cakkhupasādavatthukaṃ cittaṃ cakkhuviññāṇadhātu.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhuviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

25773.meaning1: like seeing; similar to eye consciousness; like visual awareness
25773.commentary: (DNt) tathā'pi na'y'idaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ viya sabhāvato vigat'ābhijjhaṃ, atha kho bhāvan'āvasena, ten'āha na cakkhuviññāṇasadisenā'ti.

examples.text: vigat'ābhijjhenā'ti vikkhambhanavasena pahīnattā vigat'ābhijjhena, na cakkhuviññāṇasadisenā'ti attho.

25774.meaningLit: to be known by eye knowing

examples.text: cakkhusmiṃ, āvuso, rūpe cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye ca upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.
cakkhuṃ, āvuso channa, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassasi?

25775.meaning2: to be apperceived by the sense of sight
25775.meaningLit: to be known by the eye

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda… anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu
cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kām'ūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
vaṭṭani'r'iva koṭar'ohitā, majjhe pubbuḷakā sāssukā, pīḷakoḷikā c'ettha jāyati, vividhā cakkhuvidhā ca piṇḍitā.

25777.meaning1: is able to see; gains vision

examples.text: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya, uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ natthukammaṃ. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya, cakkhūni visodheyya.

25778.meaning1: is able to see clearly; gains focus

examples.text: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya, uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ natthukammaṃ. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma cakkhūni uppādeyya, cakkhūni visodheyya.

25779.meaning2: sense faculty that is the eye

25780.meaning1: (gram) employing the word 'and'; using the word 'but'

examples.text: caggahaṇena pañcamīvibhatti'pi hoti. mā gacchāhi.
caggahaṇena āra āla'icc'ete paccayā honti. santaṃ karoti, santārati, upakkamaṃ karoti, upakkamālati.
sotatto sosinno c'eva, eko bhiṃsanake vane, naggo na c'aggim'āsīno, esanāpasuto munī'ti.

25782.meaning1: walking meditation; walking up and down (in meditation)

examples.text: so eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma
ahaṃ middhena pakato, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, caṅkamaṃ abhiruhanto, tatth'eva papatiṃ chamā.
pañcadosavivajjitan'ti, pañc'ime caṅkamadosā nāma, thaddhavisamatā, antorukkhatā, gahanacchannatā, atisambādhatā, ativisālatā'ti.

25784.meaning1: walks up and down; walks in meditation

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, ṭhitassa taṃ bhayabheravaṃ āgacchati. so kho ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, n'eva tāva caṅkamāmi na nisīdāmi na nipajjāmi. yāva ṭhito'va taṃ bhayabheravaṃ paṭivinemi.
abbhāse vattamānassa kavaggassa cavaggo hoti. cikicchati, jigucchati, jighacchati, jigīsati, jaṅgamati, caṅkamati.

puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatt'ānucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādaka-mahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.

25787.meaning2: hall or enclosure for walking about in

25788.meaning1: walking in meditation; walking up and down (in meditation)

examples.text: disvā pāsādachāyāyaṃ, caṅkamantaṃ nar'uttamaṃ, tattha naṃ upasaṅkamma, vandisaṃ puris'uttamaṃ.
thaddha-visama-bhūmibhāgasmiñ'hi caṅkame caṅkamantassa pādā rujjanti, phoṭā uṭṭhahanti, cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ na labhati, kammaṭṭhānaṃ vipajjati.

25789.meaning1: walking up and down in meditation (in)

examples.text: atha kho, assalāyana, asito devalo isi sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ patthaṇḍile caṅkamamāno evam'āha, handa, ko nu kho ime bhavanto brāhmaṇ'isayo gatā, handa, ko nu kho ime bhavanto brāhmaṇ'isayo gatā'ti?

25792.meaning1: achieved by walking meditation; acquired on the walking path
25792.commentary: (ANa) caṅkamādhigato samādhī'ti caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhahantena adhigato aṭṭhannaṃ samāpattīnaṃ aññatarasamādhi.

examples.text: addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.

25793.meaning1: walked up and down; walked in meditation

examples.text: gattāni parimajjitvā, puna'p'āruyha caṅkamaṃ, caṅkame caṅkamiṃ so'haṃ, ajjhattaṃ susamāhito.

25794.meaning1: having walked up and down; having walked in meditation (in)

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bahu'd'evarattiṃ abbhokāse caṅkamitvā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā.

25795.commentary: (MNa) caṅkī'ti ādayo pañca'pi janā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa purohitā eva.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.

25797.meaning1: basket for carrying flowers or precious items

examples.text: brāhmaṇo evam'āha, ukkhipa dvidhāpathaṃ, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti. abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa caṅgavāraṃ. caṅgavāro, bhadante'ti.
